meta.title: Task complete notice
meta.description: Shows a notice in the top-right corner of the window and plays a chime whenever the agent of a session stops running, or starts waiting for you to answer a question, review a plan, or approve an action. A finished run reads as finished, not as success: a normal completion, a failure, and the Stop button all trigger it. No notice ever closes itself: you dismiss it with the cross, or by opening the session it names, and a waiting notice also clears once you answer because the thing it waits for is gone. Up to three notices stack, and on overflow the oldest finished one yields first. Only listed top-level sessions are observed, so subagent runs stay silent. The notice is drawn inside the page and the chime is synthesised in the browser (a two-note chime for a stop, a longer three-note one for a waiting interaction), so it works only while a Harness web or desktop window is open and sends no system notification. Stack size and chime volume are constants at the top of client.js.
